release_name: Promote beta to production: diocese-confirmed corrections
notes: Promotes mauritius-mass-finder-beta v27.6.1. Every schedule change here was confirmed directly by the Diocese of Port-Louis (Virginie Julien, Public Relations Officer) on 2026-08-19, and re-read from the corrected diocese pages afterwards. (1) Two times corrected where the diocese own two pages had disagreed: L Eau Vive Chebel Sunday 08h00 -> 07h30, and Saint-Benoit Tamarin Sunday English Mass (1st Sunday) 18h00 -> 17h30. The third case queried, Notre-Dame-de-la-Mer Albion, was settled at 18h00, which we already held. (2) One Mass restored that we had wrongly removed: the Monday 19h00 Messe dans les quartiers at Plaine-Magnien. It was dropped on 2026-08-17 because no diocese page listed it; the diocese confirmed it takes place and reinstated it. Restored with its original site id, so anyone who had saved that church gets it back. The other six Masses queried were confirmed as genuinely ceased. (3) Two churches added whose diocese pages had an empty schedule: Beatitudes, Bati, Grand-Gaube (Sunday 08h00) and Notre-Dame-du-Grand-Pouvoir, Cap-Malheureux (Wednesday 18h00, second Wednesday only). (4) That second one now carries an explicit red warning in both languages, because the diocese states it is not celebrated regularly and asks people to confirm with the parish before travelling - previously that caution was stored but never shown. Corpus 414 -> 417 rows, 117 -> 120 sites.
